name: Obsidian Codex
2-piece_bonus: While the equipping character is in Nightsoul's Blessing and is on the field, their DMG dealt is increased by 15%.
4-piece_bonus: After the equipping character consumes 1 Nightsoul point while on the field, CRIT Rate increases by 40% for 6s. This effect can trigger once every second.
